description: This Java class provides helper methods for handling address-based authorization in AMQP connections, specifically supporting the Qpid Dispatch Router's ADDRESS-AUTHZ capability. It manages processing connection properties, checking capabilities, and parsing client version information.

classes.name: AddressAuthzHelper
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing AMQP address authorization capabilities, including capability checks, processing connection properties, and parsing client versions.

methods.name: isAddressAuthzCapabilitySet
methods.description: Checks if the AMQP connection's peer has indicated support for the ADDRESS-AUTHZ capability.

methods.name: processAddressAuthzCapability
methods.description: Processes the AMQP open frame by setting connection properties with user authorities and capabilities.

methods.name: isLegacyClient
methods.description: Determines if the client connection uses a legacy version based on the version string.

methods.name: parseVersionString
methods.description: Parses a version string into major, minor, and patch version numbers.

methods.name: getPermissionsFromAuthorities
methods.description: Converts Authorities object into a map of resource paths to activity permissions.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Converts a string of activity characters ('R', 'W') into an array of permission strings ('recv', 'send').
